# Working on shared fixtures

Follow [test instructions](../AGENTS.md). Put shared independent synthetic inputs
here; keep contract-owned signing/schema fixtures with their contract or package.
Use one owning definition and generator instead of divergent language copies.

Document the oracle and admitted/invalid cases. Expected bytes or values must not
be generated by the same production operation being tested without an independent
check. Preserve missing/foreign-definition and malformed-input cases through a
current-v1 cutover. Never add private datasets, credentials or installation state.

Run each affected consumer and the owning generator/check after changing a shared
fixture. A fixture update alone does not qualify its runtime consumers. Record
qualification through the [test index](../README.md#record-results).
